name: Fixed-size sliding window
whenToUse: The standard answer: one pass and one counter, no extra memory.

card.signals: "substring" (contiguous) "of given length" k (the window size never changes) and "maximum number" of vowels. The count of a window is easy to update when the window moves by one letter.
card.pattern: a fixed-size window. Build the first window of k letters, then slide it one step at a time: one letter enters on the right, one leaves on the left. Each letter is checked once on the way in and once on the way out, so the scan is O(n).
card.coreIdea: keep vowels, the number of vowels in the window. When a vowel enters, vowels += 1; when a vowel leaves, vowels -= 1. The answer is the largest vowels over all windows.

invariant: After each slide, the window s[left..right] has exactly k letters, and vowels is the number of vowels in it.
